content.paragraph1: 1. When you trade in the futures market, if market trends are unfavorable and cause losses, resulting in insufficient margin for your positions, this exchange will liquidate your positions according to system agreements and disclose liquidation details. Please take note.
content.paragraph2: 2. Please carefully read and comply with this exchange's business rules. Understand the futures mechanism and operating principles, understand various market risks, and arrange funds reasonably for trading.
content.paragraph3: 3. In certain extreme market conditions, you may find it difficult or impossible to close your open futures positions. For example, when your profits rank first in effective leverage PnL across the entire futures market, and the insurance fund is insufficient to cover the losses of losing positions.
content.paragraph4: 4. Due to changes in local laws, regulations, policies, modifications to futures exchange trading rules, or the introduction of emergency measures, this exchange will issue advance disclosure statements. Your open futures positions may not be able to continue, but the platform will still honor your position margin and profit balances!
content.paragraph5: 5. Due to reasons beyond this exchange's control, such as force majeure factors like earthquakes, floods, fires, or computer system and communication system failures, your orders may not be executed or fully executed. You may bear the resulting losses.
content.paragraph6: 6. 'Hedging' transactions, like speculative trading, also face risks from price fluctuations. Please understand the relevant mechanisms in advance.
content.paragraph7: 7. If you lend your account to someone else for operation, it may affect the security of your futures margin. Please ensure the security of your personal account.

marginMode.title: Margin Mode
marginMode.crossDescription: Cross Margin Mode: All positions share the margin in the contract account to avoid liquidation. In a liquidation event, traders may lose all margin and positions.
marginMode.isolatedDescription: Isolated Margin Mode: A certain amount of margin is allocated to positions. If the position margin falls below the maintenance margin level, the position will be liquidated. In isolated margin mode, you can add and reduce margin for this position.
